### Borea v0.6.26

A patch release for a freeze when you leave a mod page. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Fixed

- Borea froze for seconds, up to "not responding", when you opened the Versions tab of a mod and then went to Discover or to another mod. Leaving such a page is now as quick as leaving any other page. Thanks to @LaurensDeV for finding the cause and fixing it.

Full changelog: [v0.6.25...v0.6.26](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.25...v0.6.26)
